listing.aiSummary: Nerfs high-importance arms dealers to make their offerings more consistent with lower-tier dealers.

description: Reduces the number of ships, weapons, and fighters offered by very important arms dealers. This adjustment aims to align their inventory scaling with that of other importance levels.
